platform: CJSR 88.5 FM Album and EP Music Submission
manual_review_reason: CJSR accepts albums and EPs rather than individual singles. A human must approve the pitch, confirm a non-expiring downloadable delivery method, provide complete metadata, focus tracks, track lengths and language warnings, choose digital or physical delivery, and keep the separate paid local-advertising offer outside the music-submission workflow.

platform: CFUV 101.9 FM Independent Music Library Submission
manual_review_reason: CFUV requires at least three unique tracks and properly prepared downloadable 320 kbps MP3 files. A human must verify release eligibility, track listing, biography, file access, metadata, rights and the distinction between the global digital route and the local-only physical-delivery exception before sending the Music Director pitch.

platform: KXCI 91.3 FM Digital Album and Physical Music Submission
manual_review_reason: KXCI accepts digital albums by MP3 or WAV download link and physical CDs or vinyl, but the Music Department address is protected in passive extraction. A human must use the address displayed on the official page without decoding or guessing it programmatically, confirm album assets and explicit-language disclosures, approve the pitch and decide whether digital delivery alone or optional physical copies are appropriate.
